final_topology.title: Azure Hybrid Cloud Hub-Spoke
final_topology.description: Secure hybrid cloud architecture with Azure hub-spoke topology, including a private ARO cluster in the spoke and shared services in the hub, connected to on-premises via ExpressRoute.
final_topology.topology_summary: The hub contains shared services such as a firewall and a bastion host. The spoke network includes a private ARO cluster. The on-premises network has an OCP cluster and databases, connected to the hub via ExpressRoute. Public web traffic is protected by a WAF.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' node (n20) in the Security Management zone (z7), which suggests the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' node (n21) in the Security Management zone (z7), indicating the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology shows clear segmentation with different zones (Hub VNet, Spoke VNet, On-Premises Data Center, Non-Production Zone) and specific nodes for different types of workloads and services, suggesting data segmentation based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' node (n1) in the Hub VNet zone (z1), indicating the presence of a firewall.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node (n13) in the Management Zone (z5), and there is a link (nl7) from the DNS Server to the Azure Firewall, indicating DNS resolution is configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' node (n22) in the Security Management zone (z7), and there is a link (nl15) from the MFA Gateway to the Admin Workstation, indicating MFA is enforced for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n14) in the Management Zone (z5), and there is a link (nl8) from the Web Proxy to the Azure Firewall, indicating DNS filtering services are in place.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n14) in the Management Zone (z5), and there is a link (nl8) from the Web Proxy to the Azure Firewall, indicating URL filtering is enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology shows a well-defined network architecture with clear segmentation (Hub VNet, Spoke VNet, On-Premises Data Center, Non-Production Zone) and specific nodes for security functions (Firewall, Bastion Host, NIDS, etc.).

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' node (n23) in the Security Management zone (z7), and there is a link (nl16) from the IaC Repository to the Azure Firewall, indicating the use of Infrastructure-as-Code for managing network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node (n12) in the Management Zone (z5), and there are multiple links (nl5, nl6, nl10, nl11, nl12, nl13, nl14, nl15, nl16, nl17, nl18, nl19, nl20, nl21, nl22, nl23, nl24, nl25) indicating centralized AAA management.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'ExpressRoute Gateway' node (n7) in the Hub VNet zone (z1), and there are links (nl4, nl6) indicating remote connections are managed through the gateway and integrated with the Identity Server for AAA.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node (n15) in the Hub VNet zone (z1), and there is a link (nl9) from the NIDS to the SIEM, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' node (n1) in the Hub VNet zone (z1), and there are multiple links (nl1, nl2, nl3, nl4, nl5, nl6, nl7, nl8, nl9, nl10, nl11, nl12, nl13, nl14, nl15, nl16, nl17, nl18, nl19, nl20, nl21, nl22, nl23, nl24, nl25) indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Manager' node (n24) in the Security Management zone (z7), and there is a link (nl17) from the Access Control Manager to the NAC, indicating access control management for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node (n15) in the Hub VNet zone (z1), and there is a link (nl9) from the NIDS to the SIEM, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a 'Spoke VNet' (z2), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Test Management System' node (n25) in the Security Management zone (z7), indicating the presence of a system for managing periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a detailed asset inventory.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system or provide documentation of the asset inventory.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes some data flow links, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows, especially for service provider data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system or provide documentation of the data flows.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Identity Server (n12) and an Admin Workstation (n18) with management links, but there is no explicit evidence of MFA being required for remote network access.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of MFA requirement.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link explicitly indicating MFA for remote access.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network infrastructure components, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link explicitly indicating secure management practices.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Identity Server (n12) and an NAC (n17) that integrate with the Azure Firewall (n1), but there is no explicit evidence of managing access control for remote assets based on specific criteria.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control management for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link explicitly indicating access control management for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not include any explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link explicitly indicating the process for performing external penetration tests.
